sloka: ऋषयः पन्नगा दैत्या यक्षाश्चाप्यप्सरोगणाः ।युगान्तपरिवर्ते च पृथिवी समहार्णवा ।। ७.२२.२७ ॥
transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ pannagā daityā yakṣāścāpyapsarogaṇāḥ ।yugāntaparivarte ca pṛthivī samahārṇavā ।। 7.22.27 ॥

translations.english: Dambhu, the great king of Daityas, Vritra, and Bana, along with royal sages who knew the scriptures, Gandharvas, and great serpents, were also present.
